entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • C# compiler does not detect missing await in an async lambda which calls async func. #84590
  • MSBuildWorkspace API for opening file-based app projects #84588
    18.10
  • MSBuildWorkspace GetCompilation hangs when the project references itself #84587
  • [Known Build Error] Test_Windows_Desktop_Release_32: Test host process crashed #84579

Closed

  • IDE0037 is case insensitive for VB #84278
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12021.129 #84578

PullRequests

Created

  • Avoid nullref when opening XAML documents with no view adapter #84595
  • Use extension-parameter helper in object initializer DEBUG assert #84594
  • Add on-demand project loading #84591
    VSCode
  • Unions: cache some calculated results on NamedTypeSymbol representing a union type #84589
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Provide ProcDump to Helix Windows Desktop test work items #84584

Merged

  • Simplify NuGet authentication step #84593
  • Split Razor components into decl/impl before tag-helper resolution #84577
    Area-Razor
  • Remove feedUrl from NuGetAuthenticate task #84592
  • Query impl and decl documents in Razor code lens and document symbols #84586
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Defer Introduce Parameter's call-site search to when the action is applied #84572
    VSCode
  • File-based apps: avoid running a few irrelevant editor features #84575
    VSCode
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3028555 #84585
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3028554 #84583

Updated

    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Implement LSP daemon mode #84199
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Nullable annotate Symbol.ContainingType #84536
    Area-Compilers
  • Disable hidden redundant pattern diagnostics by default #84576
  • Fix: LINQ implicit anonymous type property allows ref structs, causing runtime TypeLoadException #84485
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #83901
    Area-Infrastructure, Needs API Review
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #84544
  • Allow MSBuildWorkspace to open file-based apps #84139
